title: Automate Inventory Management System Testing
desc:
Develop automated test case to test the workflow of an inventory & material management system. The system is a webapplication. 

The Test Scenario as a summary is
A Property has a warehouse where spare part inventory is stored. Maintenance requests consume the inventory in the Property warehouse. 
A material request scans the warehouse for spare parts which are under the reorder level and prepares the list of spare parts and the min qty that needs to be ordered.
The ordering process is outside the system. The spare parts once received are updated in the central warehouse inventory.
The material fulfillment team then updates the Material Request list with the received materials. The inventory in the central warehouse is reduced. When the spare parts in the Material request list is delivered at the warehouse in the property the inventory there is increased.

Different scenarios have to be chalked out, data created and automated test script created to run the test cases.

title: Build Intraday NSE Trading Algo
desc:
I want my proprietary intraday strategies on the National Stock Exchange translated into clean, production-ready Python. Your code should accept live market feeds, apply my logic in real time, and place orders automatically through the broker API I’ll provide. Before we go live, I also need a back-test harness so we can replay historical NSE ticks and verify performance side-by-side with the live engine.

Because the strategies already exist on paper, the task is purely technical: translate rules into well-structured functions, handle edge cases such as partial fills or data lags, log every decision, and expose a simple config file where I can fine-tune parameters without touching the source. Pandas, NumPy, ta-lib, and a mainstream broker SDK such as Kite or FYERS are the tools I usually see for jobs like this—use what you’re comfortable with as long as the final script behaves deterministically and is easy to audit.

I’m based in Bangalore and daily collaboration is simpler if you’re nearby, but I’m open to anyone within India who can hop on quick calls during market hours. Please share a short note on your past intraday or automated trading work on NSE, a GitHub link or executable demo of a back-test you built, and how long you’d need for:

• First working prototype with hard-coded parameters  
• Completed back-testing module with sample report  
• Final production version ready for live orders  

I’ll supply the strategy rules under NDA the moment we start.

title: Industrial Facility Load Calculation & SLD
desc:
I’m advancing the design of an industrial-use building and I need a qualified electrical engineer to wrap up two critical documents: a full electrical load calculation and a clean, code-compliant single-line diagram.  

Scope  
• Load calculation – demand factors applied, panel schedules filled out, conductor and protective-device sizing referenced to the current NEC (or the governing standard you normally use for U.S. industrial facilities).  
• Single-line diagram – clear equipment hierarchy from utility service down to the smallest distribution panel, showing breakers, feeders, grounding and fault levels. I’ll supply the architectural layout, equipment list and utility data the moment we start; you turn that into professional-grade PDF outputs plus the editable source file (Excel for the calc sheet, AutoCAD or similar for the SLD).  

What helps me choose quickly  
When you reply, highlight projects where you produced industrial electrical calculations and SLDs—give me a line or two on the plant size, voltage class and any special constraints you handled. That practical experience will weigh more than a generic portfolio.  

Timeline & checkpoints  
Draft load calc first so we can lock feeder sizes, then the annotated SLD; I’m aiming to review within five business days of each submission and wrap the whole package soon after.  

If you’re confident working with industrial loads, NEC tables and clear diagramming standards, let’s get started.

Valoro una comunicación fluida, manejo responsable de datos confidenciales y la capacidad de seguir procesos ya definidos mientras propone mejoras cuando detecte oportunidades. Si cuentas con experiencia previa en asistencia virtual y conoces herramientas habituales de facturación (por ejemplo, Excel, Google Sheets o cualquier sistema ERP), me gustaría saber cómo puedes aplicar ese conocimiento a nuestro flujo actual. 

Entrego lineamientos detallados una vez iniciado el proyecto y estoy disponible para resolver dudas durante la implementación.

title: Minimalist Faith Shorts Graphics
desc:
I run a faith-based YouTube channel and need a set of clean, minimalist shorts that put Scripture and inspirational quotes front and center. The visual style should be understated—think ample negative space and restrained color—but still engaging enough to stop the scroll in a vertical feed.

Here’s what will make the project a success for me:  

• Each short relies on text overlays as the primary design element. No complex animation is necessary; subtle motion or fades that keep the focus on the words are ideal.  
• Quotes will be supplied in a Google Doc. I simply need you to translate them into 1080 × 1920 layouts that feel cohesive as a series.  
• Consistent typography, smart hierarchy, and on-brand transitions matter more than flashy graphics. If you’d like to weave in gentle background textures or muted shapes, that’s fine as long as the words remain the hero.  
• Final output: 10 ready-to-upload .mp4 files (15–60 s each) plus the editable project files—Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Canva are all acceptable.  

Deliver the first draft of two shorts so we can lock styling, then proceed with the remaining eight. If the text is readable on mobile, colors are balanced, and the pacing feels meditative rather than rushed, we’re good to go.

title: Educational Video Script Needed -- 2
desc:
I’m preparing an instructional video aimed at an adult audience and need a polished, engaging script that turns complex information into clear, easy-to-follow content. The finished piece should flow naturally for voice-over, guide viewers through the topic step by step, and weave in concise calls to action where appropriate without sounding salesy.

Here’s what I expect as the final deliverable:
• A complete video script (voice-over dialogue plus brief visual cues) in an editable Google Doc or Word file.
• A tone that is informative and conversational, assuming a curious but non-expert viewer.
• Logical pacing so the material feels digestible, ideally timed for a video of roughly 3–5 minutes (flexible if you have a strong narrative reason).

Strong command of copywriting and scriptwriting techniques is important, as is the ability to structure educational content for maximum clarity and retention. If this sounds like your wheelhouse, I look forward to seeing how you’d bring the subject matter to life.

title: Commission-Only Medical Supplies Sales Rep -- 2
desc:
I need a self-driven sales professional who can pick up the phone and close business with clinics, urgent care centers, and other healthcare providers right across the United States. The product line is in constant demand, so your focus can remain squarely on outreach and conversion rather than creating need.

You will operate nationally and primarily through cold calling. If you already have healthcare contacts, that is a bonus, but determination, persistence, and a proven phone pitch matter most.

To help you ramp up quickly, I will provide:
• Marketing materials (brochures, spec sheets, digital assets)
• Product training so you can speak confidently with medical staff

The role is 100% commission-based; there is no salary cap, and earnings scale directly with the volume of orders you secure. All orders are tracked in real time, and commissions are released the moment payment clears.

Key expectations:
• Generate and qualify leads, then guide them to close
• Maintain your own pipeline and report weekly progress
• Uphold professional, compliant sales conduct in the healthcare sector
 
If you thrive on cold outreach, want unlimited upside, and can cover a national territory from your phone and laptop, let’s talk.

title: Darebin VicSmart Landscape Compliance Plan
desc:
I’m lodging a VicSmart application with Darebin Council and need a concise landscape plan that ticks every regulatory box. The focus is full compliance rather than grand design flair, so the drawing set must satisfy the Tree Canopy and Deep Soil requirements in the local planning scheme.

Key inclusions I require are:
• Tree canopy coverage – show all existing vegetation, calculate required versus proposed canopy areas, and illustrate them clearly on plan.  
• Deep soil analysis – indicate zones, depths and dimensions that meet the schedule, supported by a brief soil report.  
• Plant species selection – propose suitable canopy and under-storey species; I’m open to suggestions provided they are locally appropriate and satisfy council guidelines for mature spread and water-wise performance.

File formats that integrate smoothly with Council’s online portal are essential (PDF plus the original CAD or GIS file). Please annotate everything to the standards set out in the Darebin Landscape Guidelines, including north point, scale, legend and a plant schedule table.

Acceptance will be based on:
1. Council acknowledgment that all mandatory canopy and soil metrics are met.
2. Drawings ready for immediate submission without further edit.
3. A concise planting schedule cross-referenced on plan.

I’m happy to clarify any regulation clause or supply the site survey the moment we get started so we can keep the process quick and straightforward. I have a v1 of this plan with the relevant

title: B2B Sales Promo Video Creation
desc:
I’m launching a new service under my SMMA and need a punchy promo video whose single objective is to increase sales from B2B clients. Every second should nudge decision-makers toward booking a call, so the messaging has to be sharp, benefit-centric, and unmistakably action-oriented.  

The video will live on social media—mainly LinkedIn, Instagram, and paid placements—so it must grab attention in the first three seconds, stay under 60 seconds, and be delivered in both square and vertical formats without losing visual impact or clarity.  

I’ll supply brand guidelines, logos, colour codes, a rough value-prop outline, testimonials, and a few stats. You take it from there, handling everything from script refinement to the final export:  

• Scriptwriting or polish, laser-focused on conversion  
• Storyboard and motion graphics using Adobe Premiere / After Effects (or equivalent)  
• Professional voice-over and licensed background music suited to a B2B audience  
• Two aspect ratios: 1:1 and 9:16, 1080p MP4  
• One revision round after the first cut  

Acceptance criteria: the finished clip clearly states the pain point, shows the transformation, ends with a compelling CTA, and arrives fully ready to upload to social media.  

Share a similar project and your turnaround time so we can move quickly.

title: Seeking B2B Lead Generation Specialist – 25% Commission Partnership
desc:
I am an experienced Web Developer with 20+ years of expertise in building professional, high-converting websites for businesses across different industries. I am looking for a highly motivated Business Development Executive / Lead Generation Specialist who can bring qualified clients and close web development projects through LinkedIn, direct outreach, and business directories.

This is a strictly commission-based partnership, with an exceptionally competitive 25% commission on every project you successfully close.

How the Commission Works

You earn 25% of every project you close.

For example:

$500 project → $150 commission
$1,000 project → $250 commission
$2,000 project → $500commission

There is no fixed salary and no complicated commission structure. You bring the client and close the deal; I take care of the technical execution and project delivery.

Your Responsibilities
Identify businesses that need a new website, redesign, eCommerce solution, or website improvement.
Find qualified prospects through LinkedIn, Google, business directories, social media, and targeted direct outreach.
Initiate conversations and understand the prospect's requirements and budget.
Present the value of our web development services professionally.
Follow up consistently and convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
Close the project and hand over the requirements to me for development and delivery.
What I Bring to the Partnership

20+ years of web deve

title: Microsoft 365 / Power Apps ISMS Awareness Quiz with Entra ID Authentication, Random Questions and Audit Records -- 2
desc:
We need an internal quiz built in Microsoft 365 using Power Apps that helps train employees on our Information Security Management System (ISMS). 

Staff will launch it from their desktop browsers, sign in with their Entra ID (Azure AD) credentials, and answer a set of multiple-choice questions pulled at random from a larger question bank.  

Core expectations:
  
• Entra ID single sign-on so each attempt is tied to the authenticated user  
• True randomisation of questions and answer order on every run  
• Immediate scoring with clear pass / fail feedback to the participant  
• Behind-the-scenes audit logging: who took the quiz, when, score achieved, and the exact question set they received  
• Storage of questions and results inside our Microsoft 365 tenant on a SharePoint list
• Simple admin screen that lets me add, edit, or retire questions without touching the main app  
• Export or direct connection so I can analyse results later in Excel or Power BI  

Acceptance criteria :
 
1. A working Power App delivered in our tenant that meets the above points.  
2. Source tables / lists pre-populated with placeholder questions so I can see the flow end-to-end.  
3. A written hand-over guide covering configuration steps and how to maintain the question bank.  

Experience with Power Apps and Microsoft 365 training work will speed up selection.
The attached .md file is IMPORTANT please read it carefully!

title: Telegram Community Manager Needed Daily
desc:
I run a Telegram group whose core mission is lively community engagement, not just passive updates. To keep the conversation fresh I want daily touchpoints—think thought-provoking discussion starters, quick polls or surveys that gather member sentiment, and timely event announcements that boost participation.

Here’s what the role looks like from my side: you’ll step in as a visible moderator, schedule and publish at least one quality post every day, spark replies, and keep chats on-topic and respectful. You’re free to use Telegram’s native tools or a bot of your choice for scheduling, keyword alerts, or basic moderation, as long as the flow feels organic.

Deliverables  
• Minimum 7 engaging posts per week, balanced across discussions, polls, and event notices  
• Real-time moderation during peak hours (I’ll share analytics) to remove spam or off-topic content promptly  
• A short weekly recap—what resonated, what fell flat, and one idea to test next week  

Acceptance criteria  
Posts must be original, concise, and free of grammar errors; polls should close with clear results shared back to members; event announcements must include dates, times, and a CTA link. Consistent tone and brand voice are key—I’ll provide guidelines on day one.

Let’s create a Telegram space members check in on daily because they want to, not because they have to.

title: 12V Motorboat Electrical Design
desc:
I’m preparing the electrical layout for a brand-new 12 V motorboat and need an experienced marine systems designer to turn my rough concept into a build-ready package. The scope covers the entire low-voltage network that will power our lighting, navigation equipment and communication systems.

Here’s what I need from you:

• A clear, ABYC-compliant schematic (PDF and editable CAD) showing wire runs, circuit protection, bus bars, switches and grounding.  
• A complete, itemised bill of materials with manufacturer part numbers, wire gauges, breaker sizes and recommended sources.  
• Installation notes that highlight any special considerations for salt-water environments and vibration on a planing hull.  

Your design should allow for future expansion (extra nav gear or auxiliary lighting) without major rewiring, and it must integrate cleanly with the engine’s 12 V alternator and a shore-power charger. Familiarity with NMEA 2000 backbones, Blue Sea Systems hardware and modern LED load calculations will be a plus.

I’ll provide the hull layout, engine specs and any brand preferences as soon as we start. Once the first draft schematic is in, we’ll review it together, lock revisions, then finalise the parts list. If this sounds like your territory, let’s get this motorboat wired right the first time.

title: Formatted Word Data Entry
desc:
I have a batch of Word documents that need to be re-keyed exactly as they appear, including every heading style, boldface, italics, bullet list, and paragraph break. The source files are already digital, but I cannot rely on a simple copy-paste or automated converter because the original layout must remain intact in the final files.

Here’s what I need from you: open each .doc/.docx, manually enter the full text into the provided template, and replicate the formatting line for line. Accuracy matters more than speed—spelling, spacing, and style all have to match the original. I will share a short test file first; once that is approved, you can proceed with the remaining documents in small milestones so we can keep quality on track.

Deliverables  
• Clean, final Word files (or Google Docs—your choice) mirroring the exact formatting of the originals  
• A quick note alongside each file flagging any illegible characters or inconsistencies you discover

If you have solid experience with meticulous data entry in Word, this should be straightforward. Let me know your turnaround time per 10 pages and any past projects where you preserved complex text layout.

title: Minimalist Bright YouTube Thumbnail
desc:
I need a clean, minimalist thumbnail that still jumps off the YouTube feed. The design should focus on a single, well-cut-out image of the video’s main subject, framed by a thoughtfully chosen bright-colour palette. No extra text, icons, or symbols—just a striking composition that communicates the topic instantly and scales well on mobile.

Deliverables  
• One 1280 × 720 px JPG/PNG (≤ 2 MB) ready for upload  
• Source file (PSD, AI, or Figma) with fully editable layers  

Acceptance criteria  
• Minimalist layout with ample negative space  
• Bright colours balanced for easy readability, no neon overload  
• Subject image remains crisp with clean edges  
• Thumbnail remains clear at small preview sizes  

I can supply the high-resolution subject image and any branding assets as soon as we start. A 48-hour turnaround would be perfect. Share a link to similar minimalist work you’ve done and let’s get this thumbnail live.

title: Cinematic Vlog Video Editor Needed
desc:
I shoot a weekly YouTube vlog and need a reliable editor who can turn 10–12 minutes of raw footage into a polished, cinematic story every week. 

Here’s what the finished package should include:  
• A 10–12 minute edit with cinematic pacing, tasteful transitions, and well-timed B-roll.  
• Dramatic, intense background music that is royalty-free and matches the visual mood.  
• Full, word-for-word subtitles burned in and supplied separately as an .srt file.  
• A custom thumbnail that captures the episode’s main hook and stays on-brand with my channel’s color palette.  

Workflow & timing  
– I’ll share footage each Monday (Google Drive).  
– First cut is due within 72 hours.  
– One round of minor revisions, then the final 1080p (or 4K if possible) export plus thumbnail and subtitle file.  

Tools you’re comfortable with—Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve—are all fine as long as the outcome is cinematic and consistent week after week. If this sounds like your style, let’s collaborate.

title: Desain Lemari Minimalis Berbahan Logam
desc:
Saya membutuhkan seorang desainer furnitur yang bisa merancang lemari pakaian bergaya minimalis dengan material utama logam. Fokusnya murni pada tahap desain; proses produksi dan pemasaran akan saya tangani sendiri.

Kebutuhan utama:
• Konsep visual lemari minimalis yang ringkas dan fungsional.  
• Gambar teknis lengkap—ukuran detail, jenis sambungan, hingga spesifikasi lembaran/profil logam dan opsi finishing.  
• Render 3D untuk membantu presentasi produk kepada calon pembeli.  
• File sumber (CAD—DWG/STEP) beserta PDF siap cetak.

Kriteria keberhasilan:
– Garis desain bersih tanpa ornamen berlebih, sesuai estetika minimalis.  
– Struktur realistis dan efisien untuk diproduksi dari material logam yang mudah didapat di Indonesia.  
– Tata ruang internal optimal: rak, gantungan, serta satu laci dasar tetap muat dalam dimensi hemat ruang.

Saya terbuka untuk diskusi detail dan revisi wajar sampai desain siap prototipe. Portofolio desain furnitur logam akan sangat membantu. Mari berkolaborasi!

title: Vancouver Canada Auto Shop Permit Application
desc:
I am an interior designer and my client operate a car repair and maintenance facility in Vancouver that handles general repairs, specialized repairs, and routine maintenance. The space already has a full set of layout drawings from the architect who worked on the building complex; however, I now need a complete permit package prepared for the specific units that my client is modifying.  We need a full set of drawing compliant to City of Vancouver permit requirement.  The client is in a rush to move into new address.  Must be a freelancer who is able to meet via zoom meeting for discussions or even better able to meet on site in south Vancouver to do measurements.

Also this is rushed order so client require an experienced drafter familiar with Vancouver requirements so as to eliminate back and forth with the city and delays in obtaining the approval.

Here’s what I need from you:

• Review the part of the architect plans relevent to the auto shop client's unit and redraw relevent info to meet current City of Vancouver's requirement for change of use and renovation permit building permit.  Client is looking to add 3 lifts, 1 ramp, a few tire machine, and an reception/office area.
• Compile all supporting documents—code compliance summary, occupant load, exit calculations, mechanical / electrical schedules, energy checklist, and any other items the City typically requests for an auto-repair occupancy.  
• Fill out and electronically lodge the permit application, then track it t
